AGREEMENT

3 Product Cost

IGCL tenders it consent for the MOQ as desired by GGS. However, is committed to give suggestions and feed back for most cost efficienct option for GGS. IGCL confirms it commitment for Rate Contrcat and Pric agreement validity for 6 months.

4 Invoicing, Payment Terms and Set-Off Rights

IIGCL has already extended its concurrence for Payment term of 45 Days from the receipt of Original Document.

5 Lead Time

IGCL agrees for the 45 to 60 days Production Lead Time.

8 Product Warranties

IGCL is committed to produce quality products. However, in the event of a product/batch failure, IGCL tenders it's assurance to replace the goods free of cost.

9 Product Return For Excess and Other Product Returns

IGCL is committed to provide best services to GGS. However as a policy IGCL ,does not take the goods back sold one's – Neither Own Brands nor Private Labeled Brands. The scope for a batch/ product failure does not come under this perview.

11 Insurance Requirement

IGCL extends it cinfimation for 1% contribution towrds the PLI Wrap-Up.
